fact: Open Ownership says it has partnered with PACRA and GIZ to build an in-house next-generation system with a form builder and case management to digitise over one hundred PACRA services, starting with name clearance, registration and incorporation including BO declaration.
PACRA's Papias Banda said a three-year, GIZ-funded rebuild of the business register began in December 2025, with development of the new register starting in January 2026.
PACRA's Papias Banda said beneficial ownership reporting to the register stood at only 44 percent as of December 2025.
